regions.merged_text: With love and with Christmas blessings to all Comes the Infan once more to free us from sorrow Whose love and Whose power and Whose gentleness call To each heart and Each soul for a manger tomorrow Whose love and Whose Wisdom, Whose wonders proclaim Him the Son of the Virgin as promised of your. O may He estrange us from sin with its shame And reigh in our hearts as His crib ever more! God bless you Brother Patrick Glad to hear your busy. I hope you keep up your frequent and daily communions. Lord have mercy on John and Thom. It was a great consolation to know that they had been practical in this - John for 17 yrs was daily communicant. Thanks be to God. Deo Gratias.
